title: Red Chile Chicken Enchiladas with Cheddar and Lime Crema
summary: Chicken thighs simmer in a cumin and chilli tomato sauce, then are shredded with cheddar and jalapeño, rolled in warm corn tortillas, sauced and baked until bubbling.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 cm strips
mild cheddar, coarsely grated (check the rennet)
white onion, sliced into thin rings

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, chilli powder, ground coriander, cumin, sugar and 1/2 tsp salt and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant; frying the spices briefly deepens their flavour.

steps.title: Poach the chicken in the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the chicken strips, then the passata and water. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat for 8-10 minutes, until the thickest strip reaches 74 °C. Cooking the chicken in the sauce flavours both.

steps.title: Strain and shred
steps.text: Pour everything through the sieve into the bowl, pressing to keep all the sauce. Leave the chicken to cool for 5 minutes, then shred it with the forks into the large bowl and mix in the chopped coriander, jalapeño and 225 g cheddar.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and spread 180 ml of the sauce over the base of the baking dish. Brush both sides of the tortillas lightly with oil, lay them overlapping on the trays and warm them in the oven for 2-3 minutes until soft. Warm tortillas roll without cracking.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Spoon about 80 ml of filling down the centre of each tortilla, roll it up tightly and lay it seam side down in the dish, in 2 rows. Pour the remaining sauce over, making sure the ends are covered so they don't dry out, and sprinkle with the last 60 g cheddar.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes, then uncover and bake for 5 minutes more, until the cheese is melted and the centre reaches 74 °C.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Stir the soured cream and lime juice together, drizzle it over the enchiladas and scatter with the onion rings and coriander leaves. Serve 2 enchiladas per person.

tips: Cold tortillas crack when rolled; always warm them first.
Cover the tortilla ends with sauce, or they bake hard and chewy.
Check the chilli powder: mild ancho-style blends give colour without too much heat.
Assemble up to 4 hours ahead, refrigerate, and add 10 minutes to the covered baking time.
storage: Refrigerate within 1 hour and use within 3 days. Reheat once, covered, in a 180 °C oven until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
